items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps dry-feeling skin comfortable while it adjusts to retinol.
The lower 0.3% strength is a gentle starting point for smoother-looking texture and more even-looking tone.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream adds comfort and moisture to skin that scanned low on moisture.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides protects daily while using retinol and suits deeper skin tones without a white cast.

response.routine_note: Start the retinol just two nights a week after cleansing, then moisturize, and build up slowly only if skin feels comfortable. Wear the SPF every morning, and pause the retinol if skin feels stinging or tight.
